title: Risk explorer
lead: Colour Tanzania by overall risk, a dimension or any of its {{count}} indicator groups. Select an area to see what drives its score.

note.council: {{count}} councils (NBS 2022), the headline level. Hazard & Exposure is computed for each council; vulnerability and coping come from the council’s INFORM source unit.
note.region: {{count}} regions, aggregated from their councils the INFORM way (indicator means, then the scaled geometric mean).
note.source: The {{count}} units of the INFORM SADC 2024 workbook, shown for reference. Councils are the headline level.

lens.label: Colour by
lens.groupsHint: Choose a dimension to see its indicator groups, such as Flood or Drought under Hazard & Exposure.

resolution.district: District: shared by the councils of a district
resolution.region: Region: survey estimate, the same for every council in the region
resolution.national: National: one value for the whole country

legend.label: Legend & filter
legend.filterHint: Click a class to filter the map and the ranking.
legend.continuousNote: Single indicators use a continuous 0–10 scale. INFORM defines classes only for overall risk and the three dimensions, so indicator values are not classified.
legend.continuousShort: Continuous 0–10 scale · INFORM has no classes for single indicators

honesty.label: About these scales
honesty.title: How to read the colours
honesty.indicator: Single-indicator lenses use a continuous 0–10 scale: INFORM defines classes only for overall risk and the three dimensions.
honesty.dimension: Risk and each dimension have their own INFORM class thresholds, so the same score can fall in different classes.
honesty.national: The national value is the official INFORM Tanzania figure, not an average of councils or regions.

stats.label: Statistics
stats.missing_one: {{count}} area has no data for this lens.
stats.missing_other: {{count}} areas have no data for this lens.

share.copiedDesc: Anyone with the link opens this exact view.

card.label: Details for {{name}}
card.driversHint: Highest-scoring indicators (0–10). Select one to colour the map by it.
card.regionNote_one: Aggregated from {{count}} council with the INFORM method.
card.regionNote_other: Aggregated from {{count}} councils with the INFORM method.
card.sourceNote: Reference unit from the INFORM SADC 2024 workbook. Councils are the headline level.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.full: You can compare up to {{max}} areas
compare.fullHint: Remove one from the comparison tray first.
